events.summary_en: Kiro Mobile is available on Google Play, so users can work in Kiro cloud sessions from an Android phone without keeping a laptop on. After signing in with a Kiro account, sessions, connected repositories and model choices are already there. The app requires a Pro, Pro+, Pro Max or Power plan.
key_points_en: Available on Google Play.
Cloud sessions work without keeping a laptop on.
Requires Pro, Pro+, Pro Max or Power.
events.importance_reason_en: Mobile access decouples cloud sessions from an always-on desktop, widening use for continuous agent work.

events.title_zh: Devin 重做 Review 页面并增加自动修复开关
events.summary_zh: Devin 11 月 12 日更新向所有组织开放重设计的 Devin Review 页面：合并控制、操作菜单和 diff 大小移至顶栏，侧边栏可收起，发现项改用新卡片与面板。新增独立的“自动修复 Devin Review 发现项”设置，与“响应机器人”分开。安全扫描可同步到多个连接，发现项状态变更可撤销，并新增 Veracode 与 Black Duck 发现项来源（封闭测试）。
key_points_zh: 重设计的 Devin Review 页面向所有组织开放。
自动修复发现项成为独立设置，与响应机器人分开。
安全扫描可同步到多个外部连接。
发现项驳回或标记已审阅后可用 Undo 撤销。
新增 Veracode 与 Black Duck 发现项来源（封闭测试）。
events.importance_reason_zh: 审查界面与自动修复开关同时调整，改变了 PR 审查的默认自动化程度和团队配置方式。
events.title_en: Devin redesigns Review and adds a separate auto-fix setting
events.summary_en: Devin’s November 12 update makes the redesigned Devin Review page available to all organizations: merge controls, the actions menu and the diff-size pill move to the top bar, the sidebar collapses, and findings use new cards and panels. A new “Automatically fix Devin Review findings” setting is separate from “Responding to bots.” Security scans can sync to multiple connections, finding status changes can be undone, and Veracode and Black Duck finding sources arrive in closed beta.
key_points_en: The redesigned Devin Review page is available to all organizations.
Auto-fixing findings is now a separate setting from responding to bots.
Security scans can sync to multiple external connections.
Dismissing or reviewing a finding can be undone.
Adds Veracode and Black Duck finding sources in closed beta.
events.importance_reason_en: The review UI and auto-fix switch change the default automation level and how teams configure pull-request review.

events.title_zh: Google 发布 AlphaGenome 2 基因组模型
events.summary_zh: Google 发布 AlphaGenome 2，称其可预测 DNA 序列及其变异如何影响特定人类细胞类型与疾病。官方摘要未给出模型规模、评测数字或访问方式。
key_points_zh: 预测 DNA 序列与变异的影响。
区分特定人类细胞类型。
面向疾病相关研究，未公布访问方式。
events.importance_reason_zh: 基因组模型的预测粒度影响致病机制与靶点研究的工作方式，但本次公告缺少可比数据。
events.title_en: Google releases AlphaGenome 2
events.summary_en: Google released AlphaGenome 2, which it says predicts how DNA sequences and their variations affect specific human cell types and disease. The summary gives no model size, benchmark numbers or access details.
key_points_en: Predicts the impact of DNA sequences and variants.
Resolves effects by specific human cell type.
Aimed at disease research; access details were not disclosed.
events.importance_reason_en: Finer-grained genomic prediction shapes how disease mechanisms and targets are studied, though this announcement lacks comparable data.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 称逾 2 万名退伍军人领取一年免费 ChatGPT Plus
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示已有超过 2 万名退伍军人与即将退役的军人领取一年免费 ChatGPT Plus，并介绍了他们用该服务准备转业的过程。官方摘要未说明资格审核方式与活动截止时间。
key_points_zh: 面向退伍军人与即将退役的军人。
提供一年免费 ChatGPT Plus。
官方称已超过 2 万人领取。
events.importance_reason_zh: 这是面向特定人群的订阅权益扩展，对计划采购的教育与转业培训项目有直接参考价值。
events.title_en: OpenAI says more than 20,000 veterans claimed a free year of ChatGPT Plus
events.summary_en: OpenAI said more than 20,000 veterans and transitioning service members have claimed a free year of ChatGPT Plus, and described how they use it to prepare for civilian careers. The summary does not explain eligibility checks or when the offer ends.
key_points_en: Targeted at veterans and transitioning service members.
Provides a free year of ChatGPT Plus.
OpenAI says more than 20,000 people have claimed it.
events.importance_reason_en: A subscription benefit aimed at a specific group matters for training and transition programs planning tool budgets.

events.title_zh: GitHub App 可管理企业级 Copilot 席位
events.summary_zh: 企业级 GitHub App 现可调用企业级 Copilot 席位管理 API，控制哪些用户与企业团队获得 Copilot 席位。该能力通过新增的“Enterprise Copilot license management”细粒度权限授予。
key_points_zh: 企业级 GitHub App 可调用席位管理 API。
可管理机构内用户与团队的席位分配。
需新增的企业级细粒度权限。
events.importance_reason_zh: 席位分配可编程后，企业能把 Copilot 授权接入现有的身份与采购自动化。
events.title_en: GitHub Apps can manage enterprise Copilot seats
events.summary_en: Enterprise GitHub Apps can now call the enterprise-level Copilot seat management APIs to control which users and enterprise teams are assigned Copilot seats. Access comes through a new enterprise fine-grained permission, Enterprise Copilot license management.
key_points_en: Enterprise GitHub Apps can call the seat management APIs.
Assignments can be managed for users and enterprise teams.
Requires the new enterprise fine-grained permission.
events.importance_reason_en: Programmable seat assignment lets enterprises wire Copilot licensing into existing identity and procurement automation.

events.title_zh: Google 发布 A2UI 1.0：面向 Agent 的生成式 UI 开放协议
events.summary_zh: Google 发布 A2UI 1.0，这是一个用于生成式 UI 的开放协议，让 AI Agent 在 Web、移动和桌面应用中渲染可交互的原生界面。项目提供 React、Angular、Lit、Flutter、SwiftUI 与 Jetpack Compose 渲染器 SDK，以及 Python、TypeScript、Dart 的 Agent SDK。1.0 版本引入双向函数调用、可替换的推理格式和安全数据绑定，方便团队把生成式 UI 接入现有产品栈。
key_points_zh: 开放协议，让 Agent 渲染 Web、移动与桌面的原生交互界面。
提供 React、Angular、Lit、Flutter、SwiftUI、Jetpack Compose 渲染器 SDK。
提供 Python、TypeScript、Dart 的 Agent SDK。
1.0 增加双向函数调用、可替换推理格式与安全数据绑定。
events.importance_reason_zh: 生成式 UI 从各家私有实现走向开放协议与多框架 SDK，会降低 Agent 前端集成的迁移成本。
events.title_en: Google releases A2UI 1.0, an open protocol for agent-generated interfaces
events.summary_en: Google released A2UI 1.0, an open protocol for generative UI that lets AI agents render interactive native screens across web, mobile and desktop apps. It provides renderer SDKs for React, Angular, Lit, Flutter, SwiftUI and Jetpack Compose, plus agent SDKs for Python, TypeScript and Dart. Version 1.0 adds bidirectional function calls, swappable inference formats and secure data binding for integrating generative UI into existing product stacks.
key_points_en: An open protocol for agents to render native interactive screens on web, mobile and desktop.
Renderer SDKs for React, Angular, Lit, Flutter, SwiftUI and Jetpack Compose.
Agent SDKs for Python, TypeScript and Dart.
1.0 adds bidirectional function calls, swappable inference formats and secure data binding.
events.importance_reason_en: Generative UI moves from proprietary implementations toward an open protocol with multi-framework SDKs, lowering migration costs for agent frontends.

corrections.reason_zh: RSSHub 条目只提供日期，原事件误用了 00:00 时间；改为日期精度，避免伪造具体时刻。
corrections.reason_en: The RSSHub entry supplies only a date, so the original event wrongly used a 00:00 time. It now uses date precision to avoid implying an exact time.

events.title_zh: MiniMax 发布开源图像模型 H3-Image：4K 生成进入 10 秒级
events.summary_zh: MiniMax 发布基于 H3 的开源权重图像生成模型 H3-Image，支持文生图、参考图生成和图像编辑。官方称可在 10 秒内生成 4096×4096 的 4K 图像，速度最高为主流方案的 5 倍，并能理解最多 16 张参考图。模型同时通过 MiniMax API、MiniMax Code 和 Hailuo AI 提供，定价为主流同类方案的 50%–70%，发布周 4K 及以上分辨率请求再打五折。
key_points_zh: 开源权重，支持文生图、参考图生成和图像编辑。
10 秒内生成 4096×4096 图像，最高 5 倍于主流方案。
最多支持 16 张参考图。
可通过 MiniMax API、MiniMax Code 与 Hailuo AI 使用。
定价为主流方案的 50%–70%，发布周 4K 及以上请求五折。
events.importance_reason_zh: 开源权重的高分辨率图像模型把 4K 生成的速度和价格同时拉低，会直接影响创作者与 API 用户的模型选择。
events.title_en: MiniMax releases open-weight H3-Image, bringing 4K generation under 10 seconds
events.summary_en: MiniMax released H3-Image, an open-weight image generation model built on H3 that supports text-to-image, reference-based generation and image editing. MiniMax says it can produce a 4096×4096 image in under 10 seconds, up to 5× faster than mainstream alternatives, and can work with up to 16 reference images. It is available through the MiniMax API, MiniMax Code and Hailuo AI; pricing is 50–70% of comparable mainstream offerings, with a further 50% off 4K-and-above requests during launch week.
key_points_en: Open weights with text-to-image, reference-based generation and editing.
A 4096×4096 image in under 10 seconds, up to 5× faster than mainstream options.
Support for up to 16 reference images.
Available through the MiniMax API, MiniMax Code and Hailuo AI.
Priced at 50–70% of mainstream alternatives, with 50% off 4K-and-above requests in launch week.
events.importance_reason_en: An open-weight high-resolution image model lowers both latency and price for 4K generation, directly affecting creator and API model choices.

events.title_zh: 硅基流动上线 MiniMax H3：0.5 元/秒生成带立体声视频
events.summary_zh: 硅基流动上线 MiniMax 开源的 MiniMax H3（FL2VA），开发者可通过 API 生成带原生立体声音的视频，并支持输入首帧、尾帧或首尾双帧控制关键画面。模型采用 33B 单流 H3-Omni Transformer 联合预测视频与音频，并重构 H3-VAE 以降低训练与推理成本。硅基流动定价 0.5 元/秒，支持生成 5–15 秒、480P 或 768P 的带音轨视频。
key_points_zh: 支持文生视频与首帧、尾帧、首尾双帧控制。
原生立体声音视频同步生成。
33B 单流 H3-Omni Transformer 联合预测视频与音频。
硅基流动定价 0.5 元/秒。
events.importance_reason_zh: 把带原生音频的视频生成接入国内 API 并按秒计价，为广告、电商与游戏内容生产提供了可直接核算成本的方案。
events.title_en: SiliconFlow adds MiniMax H3 with native-stereo video at ¥0.5 per second
events.summary_en: SiliconFlow added MiniMax’s open-source MiniMax H3 (FL2VA), letting developers generate video with native stereo audio through its API and control key frames with a first frame, last frame or both. The model uses a 33B single-stream H3-Omni Transformer to predict video and audio jointly and a rebuilt H3-VAE to cut training and inference costs. SiliconFlow prices it at ¥0.5 per second for 5–15 second clips at 480P or 768P with an audio track.
key_points_en: Text-to-video plus first-frame, last-frame and first/last-frame control.
Native stereo audio generated together with video.
A 33B single-stream H3-Omni Transformer predicts video and audio jointly.
Priced at ¥0.5 per second on SiliconFlow.
Supports 5–15 second clips at 480P or 768P.
events.importance_reason_en: Native-audio video generation with per-second pricing gives advertising, e-commerce and game teams a directly costable production option.

events.title_zh: Devin 增加 Design Mode、服务用户筛选与堆叠 PR 视图
events.summary_zh: Devin 11 月 11 日更新加入 Design Mode：选中页面元素后打开紧凑提示栏，可按属性编辑，绘制五种颜色的聚光灯框或铅笔标注，并把带注释的页面图连同说明发送；支持取色器和页面 CSS 变量搜索。会话列表的“创建者”筛选纳入服务用户，堆叠 PR 增加可见性与顺序偏好，相邻仓库设置建议可批量批准，Devin 也能给自己设置未来提醒。
key_points_zh: Design Mode 支持逐属性编辑、五种颜色标注与页面图发送。
支持取色器与页面 CSS 变量搜索。
会话列表可按服务用户筛选。
堆叠 PR 增加可见性与顺序偏好。
仓库设置建议可批量批准，Devin 可自我提醒。
events.importance_reason_zh: Design Mode 把视觉修改与自然语言说明合并到同一反馈回路，减少前端任务的往返沟通。
events.title_en: Devin adds Design Mode, service-user filtering and stacked-PR visibility
events.summary_en: Devin’s November 11 update adds Design Mode: selecting a page element opens a compact prompt bar with per-property editing, spotlight boxes or pencil annotations in five colors, and the option to send the annotated page image with a note, plus an eyedropper and page CSS-variable search. The sessions list can filter by service user, stacked PRs gain visibility and order preferences, adjacent repository setup suggestions can be approved together, and Devin can set itself future reminders.
key_points_en: Design Mode offers per-property editing, five annotation colors and annotated-page sending.
Includes an eyedropper and page CSS-variable search.
Session lists can filter by service user.
Stacked PRs gain visibility and stack-order preferences.
Repository setup suggestions can be batch-approved, and Devin can set its own reminders.
events.importance_reason_en: Design Mode folds visual edits and natural-language notes into one feedback loop, cutting back-and-forth on frontend tasks.

events.title_zh: xAI 发布 Grok Bot 1.0
events.summary_zh: xAI 发布 Grok Bot 1.0：自 beta 以来新增三人协作、主动承担与能力提升三方面改进，Bot 可共享并接入 Slack、Microsoft Teams 与视频通话，能识别待办工作并跟进任务。
key_points_zh: Grok Bot 结束 beta 发布 1.0 版。
多人协作：Bot 可共享并带入 Slack、Microsoft Teams 与视频通话，从共事者身上学习并持续改进。
主动性：Bot 可识别需要完成的工作并主动承担，跟进未完成任务，并在需要人类判断时引入人。
events.importance_reason_zh: Grok Bot 正式版明确其产品形态与团队协作能力，属产品正式发布节点。
events.title_en: xAI launches Grok Bot 1.0
events.summary_en: xAI launched Grok Bot 1.0 with three major improvements since beta: multiplayer teammates, proactive teammates, and more capable teammates; Bots can be shared, brought into Slack, Microsoft Teams, and video calls, recognize work that needs doing, and follow up on unfinished tasks.
key_points_en: Grok Bot 1.0 ends the beta period as a major update.
Multiplayer teammates: Bots can be shared and brought into Slack, Microsoft Teams, and video calls, learning from everyone they work with.
Proactive teammates: Bots recognize work that needs to be done, offer to take it on, follow up on unfinished tasks, and bring people in when a decision requires their judgment.
events.importance_reason_en: The 1.0 release defines the product form and team-collaboration capabilities of Grok Bot.

events.title_zh: Gemini CLI 0.68.0 增加扩展校验命令
events.summary_zh: Gemini CLI 0.68.0 增加扩展校验命令与相应评测测试，修复终端宽度变化后的内联历史重绘、Windows 路径大小写判断、回填搜索前导斜杠导致的自动补全问题，以及在加载指示器中显示 429 限流冷却倒计时；开启动态模型配置且关闭预览时，/model 会列出 Auto。
key_points_zh: 新增扩展校验命令与评测测试。
修复终端宽度变化后的历史重绘。
429 限流时在加载指示器显示冷却倒计时。
events.importance_reason_zh: 扩展校验让第三方扩展在发布前发现问题，限流倒计时则减少盲目重试。
events.title_en: Gemini CLI 0.68.0 adds an extension validation command
events.summary_en: Gemini CLI 0.68.0 adds an extension validation command with evaluation tests, fixes inline history re-rendering after terminal width changes, case-insensitive path handling on Windows, leading-slash normalization in file search autocomplete, and surfaces 429 rate-limit cool-downs with a countdown in the loading indicator. /model now lists Auto when dynamic model configuration is on and preview access is off.
key_points_en: Adds an extension validation command and evaluation tests.
Fixes history re-rendering after terminal width changes.
Shows a 429 cool-down countdown in the loading indicator.
events.importance_reason_en: Extension validation catches problems before publishing, and the countdown reduces blind retries.

events.title_zh: Copilot CLI 的 C++ 语言服务器自动配置 MSBuild
events.summary_zh: 微软 C++ 语言服务器为 Copilot CLI 内置 MSBuild 编译命令提取器，并在打开项目时自动调用，代理无需再查找并运行配置技能即可生成 compilation database。官方称这减少了准备步骤与 token 消耗；CMake 与自定义构建系统仍需自行提供或生成 compile_commands.json。
key_points_zh: 内置 MSBuild 编译命令提取器并自动调用。
无需代理先运行配置技能即可获得代码智能。
CMake 与自定义构建系统仍需自行生成 compile_commands.json。
events.importance_reason_zh: 把编译数据库生成内置化，减少了大型 C++ 项目首次索引的准备时间与 token 开销。
events.title_en: Copilot CLI's C++ language server configures MSBuild automatically
events.summary_en: The Microsoft C++ Language Server for Copilot CLI now bundles its MSBuild compile-commands extractor and invokes it on project open, so an agent no longer needs to discover and run a configuration skill before generating a compilation database. Microsoft says this makes setup deterministic and uses fewer tokens; CMake and custom build systems still need their own compile_commands.json.
key_points_en: The MSBuild extractor is bundled and invoked automatically.
Agents get code intelligence without a separate setup skill.
CMake and custom build systems still supply their own compilation database.
events.importance_reason_en: Building the compilation database in reduces setup time and token spend for first-time indexing of large C++ projects.

events.title_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.109 支持 Fable 5.2 与 CIDR 沙箱规则
events.summary_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.109 在模型选择器中加入 Claude Fable 5.2，并让沙箱主机允许/拒绝规则支持 IPv4 与 IPv6 CIDR；并行文件操作选择“不再询问”后会批准全部覆盖请求，/compact 完成后页脚的 AI credits 立即更新。
key_points_zh: 模型选择器新增 Claude Fable 5.2。
沙箱主机规则支持 IPv4/IPv6 CIDR。
并行文件操作的“不再询问”一次覆盖全部请求。
events.importance_reason_zh: CIDR 规则让企业可以按网段配置沙箱出口，而不必逐条列出主机。
events.title_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.109 adds Claude Fable 5.2 and CIDR sandbox rules
events.summary_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.109 adds Claude Fable 5.2 to the model picker and supports IPv4/IPv6 CIDR in sandbox host allow and deny rules. Choosing "don't ask again" for parallel file operations now approves all covered requests, and the footer's AI credits update as soon as /compact finishes.
key_points_en: Claude Fable 5.2 appears in the model picker.
Sandbox host rules accept IPv4/IPv6 CIDR ranges.
"Don't ask again" covers all parallel file operation requests.
events.importance_reason_en: CIDR rules let enterprises pin sandbox egress by network range instead of listing hosts one by one.

events.title_zh: Gemini 4 Carbon 正式可用，Copilot 与 Antigravity 同步接入
events.summary_zh: Google 宣布 Gemini 4 Carbon 正式可用。GitHub 同日说明称该模型面向复杂编码、智能体与推理任务，侧重安全代码生成与安全工作，在 Copilot 中面向 Pro+、Max、Business 与 Enterprise 用户提供并按下标价计费；Google Antigravity 也发布“Gemini 4 Carbon and /swarm”公告。该模型此前于 10 月 28 日以受限方式发布。
key_points_zh: 10 月 28 日的受限发布转为正式可用。
定位复杂编码、智能体与推理任务，侧重安全代码生成。
Copilot 向 Pro+、Max、Business 与 Enterprise 开放，按用量计费。
Antigravity 同日发布 Gemini 4 Carbon 与 /swarm 公告。
events.importance_reason_zh: 从受限开放转为全面可用，意味着团队可以把这一前沿模型放进常规编码与安全工作流。
events.title_en: Gemini 4 Carbon reaches general availability in Copilot and Antigravity
events.summary_en: Google announced that Gemini 4 Carbon is generally available. In its same-day post, GitHub describes the model as built for complex coding, agentic and reasoning tasks with a focus on secure code generation and security work, and offers it in Copilot to Pro+, Max, Business and Enterprise users at provider list pricing. Google Antigravity also published a "Gemini 4 Carbon and /swarm" post. The model had launched on October 28 with limited access.
key_points_en: The October 28 limited release becomes generally available.
Positioned for complex coding, agentic and reasoning tasks with a security focus.
Copilot access for Pro+, Max, Business and Enterprise under usage-based billing.
Antigravity published a same-day Gemini 4 Carbon and /swarm post.
events.importance_reason_en: Moving from restricted access to general availability lets teams place this frontier model in everyday coding and security workflows.

events.title_zh: Google 发布 AlphaProof Code，用 Lean 验证 Signal 核心加密
events.summary_zh: Google 发布 AlphaProof Code，称其在深度验证复杂软件方面取得突破：由智能体在 Lean 中编写约 300 万行证明，用于验证 Signal 的核心加密实现。官方摘要未说明耗时、成本或对外开放方式。
key_points_zh: 面向复杂软件的形式化验证。
智能体在 Lean 中编写约 300 万行证明。
验证对象为 Signal 的核心加密实现。
events.importance_reason_zh: 把形式化验证推进到真实生产级加密代码，是判断 AI 能否参与安全关键软件工程的重要案例。
events.title_en: Google introduces AlphaProof Code, verifying Signal's core encryption in Lean
events.summary_en: Google introduced AlphaProof Code, claiming a breakthrough in verifying complex software at depth: agents wrote about three million lines of Lean proofs to verify Signal's core encryption. The summary does not give runtime, cost or how outside teams can use it.
key_points_en: Targets formal verification of complex software.
Agents wrote roughly three million lines of Lean proofs.
The verification target was Signal's core encryption.
events.importance_reason_en: Pushing formal verification into real production cryptography is a key test of whether AI can join safety-critical software work.

events.title_zh: OpenCode 2.2.7 支持 Copilot Auto 与标记未读
events.summary_zh: OpenCode 2.2.7 在模型选择器中支持 GitHub Copilot Auto，由 Copilot 路由按 Auto 折扣为每个会话选模型，路由失败时回退到账户默认模型；新增侧栏标签快捷键、会话标记未读、read 工具负偏移与文件名近似建议，shell 结果附带退出码。破坏性变更包括移除 @opencode/ai 的 ImageResponse.image，以及部分 SDK 端点不再等待插件加载。
key_points_zh: 模型选择器可选 Copilot Auto，按 Auto 折扣计费。
read 支持负偏移，找不到文件时给出近似路径。
SDK 部分端点不再等待插件加载，需要监听 *.updated 事件。
events.importance_reason_zh: 接入 Copilot Auto 把模型路由交给供应商，同时 SDK 行为变化要求集成方调整刷新逻辑。
events.title_en: OpenCode 2.2.7 adds Copilot Auto and unread markers
events.summary_en: OpenCode 2.2.7 lets you pick GitHub Copilot Auto in the model picker, so Copilot's router chooses a model per session at the Auto discount and falls back to the account default if routing fails. It adds side-panel tab shortcuts, marking sessions unread, a negative read offset with close-name suggestions, and exit codes on shell results. Breaking changes include removing ImageResponse.image from @opencode/ai and SDK endpoints that no longer wait for plugins to load.
key_points_en: Copilot Auto is selectable and billed at the Auto discount.
read accepts negative offsets and suggests close file names.
Some SDK endpoints no longer wait for plugins; listen for *.updated events.
events.importance_reason_en: Copilot Auto hands model routing to the provider, while the SDK change forces integrations to refresh on events.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 在 ChatGPT 内推出商家资料管理
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 推出 Businesses in ChatGPT，让商家在 ChatGPT 内管理企业信息、查看自身在 ChatGPT 中的展示情况，并把用户关注转化为行动。官方摘要未披露适用地区、收费方式或上线时间。
key_points_zh: 商家可在 ChatGPT 内管理企业信息。
可查看自身在 ChatGPT 中的展示情况。
目标是把握用户关注并转化为行动。
events.importance_reason_zh: 把商家资料纳入 ChatGPT，意味着对话入口开始承载本地商家与转化链路。
events.title_en: OpenAI introduces Businesses in ChatGPT
events.summary_en: OpenAI introduced Businesses in ChatGPT so businesses can manage their information, see how they show up in ChatGPT and turn interest into action inside ChatGPT. The summary does not disclose regions, pricing or launch timing.
key_points_en: Businesses can manage their company information inside ChatGPT.
They can see how the business appears in ChatGPT.
The goal is turning user interest into action.
events.importance_reason_en: Putting business profiles inside ChatGPT shows the chat entry point starting to carry merchant discovery and conversion.

events.title_zh: 美团以 MIT 协议开源 LongCat-2.5
events.summary_zh: 美团以 MIT 协议开源 LongCat-2.5，允许商用推理部署与二次训练，无需额外授权。模型总参数 1.6 万亿、每 token 激活约 480 亿，支持一百万上下文。官方称可在单卡显存不足 80GB 的国产加速器上完成长序列训练与微调，长序列 SFT 的单卡吞吐较 DDP 基线提升 86%。
key_points_zh: MIT 协议开源，允许商用推理部署与二次训练。
总参数 1.6 万亿，每 token 激活约 480 亿，支持 100 万上下文。
单卡显存不足 80GB 的国产加速器可承载长序列训练。
长序列 SFT 单卡吞吐较 DDP 基线提升 86%。
events.importance_reason_zh: 开放权重与国产算力适配一起降低了万亿级 MoE 的自部署门槛，也给出可复现的长序列训练配置。
events.title_en: Meituan open-sources LongCat-2.5 under the MIT license
events.summary_en: Meituan open-sourced LongCat-2.5 under the MIT license, allowing commercial inference deployment and further training without extra permission. The model has 1.6T total parameters with about 48B activated per token and a one-million-token context. Meituan says long-context training and fine-tuning run on domestic accelerators with under 80GB of memory per card, and that its FSDP configuration reached 86% higher per-card throughput than a DDP baseline on long-sequence SFT.
key_points_en: MIT-licensed, permitting commercial inference and further training.
1.6T total parameters, about 48B active per token, 1M-token context.
Long-sequence training fits domestic accelerators with under 80GB per card.
Long-sequence SFT throughput is 86% higher than a DDP baseline.
events.importance_reason_en: Open weights plus domestic-accelerator tuning lower the barrier to self-hosting a trillion-parameter MoE and give a reproducible long-context training setup.

events.title_zh: Hermes Agent 0.23.1 修复插件目录被静默回退
events.summary_zh: Hermes Agent 0.23.1 为补丁版本，汇总自 0.23.0 以来的约 618 个 PR。主要修复是：线上插件目录 JSON 超过客户端 2 MiB 上限，导致每次安装都静默回退到随版本发布的旧目录；本次把上限提高到 16 MiB。仍停留在 0.23.0 及更早版本的安装会继续回退。发行说明另提到 TUI Esc 回溯、跨机群聊与网关连接共享等未在此文档化的变更。
key_points_zh: 插件目录超过 2 MiB 上限导致安装回退到旧目录。
上限提高到 16 MiB，恢复使用线上目录。
0.23.0 及更早版本在升级前仍会回退。
events.importance_reason_zh: 未升级的实例拿不到新插件且没有报错，属于容易被忽略的功能性故障。
events.title_en: Hermes Agent 0.23.1 fixes a silent plugin catalog fallback
events.summary_en: Hermes Agent 0.23.1 is a patch release rolling up about 618 PRs merged since 0.23.0. Its main fix: the live plugin catalog exceeded the 2 MiB cap clients accept, so every install silently fell back to the catalog shipped with the release. This release raises the cap to 16 MiB. Installs still on 0.23.0 or older keep falling back. The notes also mention TUI Esc backtrack, cross-machine group chats and shared gateway connections without full documentation.
key_points_en: The catalog outgrew the 2 MiB cap and installs fell back to the bundled copy.
The cap rises to 16 MiB so the live catalog is used again.
Installs on 0.23.0 or older keep falling back until updated.
events.importance_reason_en: Un-upgraded instances quietly miss new plugins without an error, which is easy to overlook.

events.title_zh: OpenRouter 推出 Extractions API
events.summary_zh: OpenRouter 发布 Extractions API，用于从文档与图片中提取带类型的字段：指定字段后返回取值、位置与置信度。上线时由三个模型提供该能力；在 Cloudflare 的 Clairic 上，同一请求可读取文本与图片并返回数字、日期、列表、估算与预测。
key_points_zh: 按字段名提取取值、位置与置信度。
上线时由三个模型提供。
同一请求可同时处理文本与图片。
events.importance_reason_zh: 把结构化抽取做成独立 API，减少为每类文档维护提示词与后处理的工作量。
events.title_en: OpenRouter introduces the Extractions API
events.summary_en: OpenRouter introduced the Extractions API for pulling typed fields out of documents and images: name the fields and get values, spans and confidence back. Three models serve it at launch. On Cloudflare's Clairic, a single request reads text and images and returns numbers, dates, lists, estimates and forecasts.
key_points_en: Returns values, spans and confidence for named fields.
Three models serve it at launch.
One request can read both text and images.
events.importance_reason_en: A dedicated extraction API cuts the work of maintaining prompts and post-processing for each document type.

events.title_zh: Google AI Edge Gallery 增加端侧离线语音识别与合成
events.summary_zh: Google AI Edge Gallery 新增端侧、离线的自动语音识别（ASR）与文本转语音（TTS）能力，面向语音应用开发。Android 可使用 ML Kit 获得优化性能，跨平台则可通过 MediaPipe Tasks 与 LiteRT 集成开放权重模型。该本地管线可与 Gemini Nano、Gemma 4 等端侧小模型配合，实现实时流式转写和低延迟语音合成。
key_points_zh: 新增端侧离线 ASR 与 TTS。
Android 可通过 ML Kit 使用优化实现。
跨平台可通过 MediaPipe Tasks 与 LiteRT 集成开放权重模型。
可与 Gemini Nano、Gemma 4 等端侧小模型组合。
events.importance_reason_zh: 离线语音链路补齐了端侧 Agent 的输入输出能力，减少对云端的依赖。
events.title_en: Google AI Edge Gallery adds on-device offline speech recognition and synthesis
events.summary_en: Google AI Edge Gallery now supports on-device, offline automatic speech recognition and text-to-speech for voice applications. Android can use ML Kit for optimized performance, while cross-platform apps can integrate open-weight models through MediaPipe Tasks and LiteRT. The local pipeline can pair with on-device small models such as Gemini Nano and Gemma 4 for real-time streaming transcription and low-latency synthesis.
key_points_en: Adds on-device, offline ASR and TTS.
Android can use ML Kit for an optimized implementation.
Cross-platform apps can use MediaPipe Tasks and LiteRT with open-weight models.
Works with on-device models such as Gemini Nano and Gemma 4.
events.importance_reason_en: An offline speech pipeline completes on-device agent input and output, reducing cloud dependence.

corrections.reason_zh: RSSHub 条目只提供日期，原事件误用了 00:00 时间；改为日期精度，避免伪造具体时刻。
corrections.reason_en: The RSSHub entry supplies only a date, so the original event wrongly used a 00:00 time. It now uses date precision to avoid implying an exact time.

events.title_zh: Kiro 实验支持 Grok 4.7，200K 内按 2.7 倍 credits 计费
events.summary_zh: Grok 4.7 以实验性支持上线 Kiro IDE、CLI、Crew 与 Web，面向 Pro、Pro+、Pro Max 与 Power 用户，提供 50 万 token 上下文。20 万 token 以内的请求按 2.7 倍 credits 计费，超过 20 万 token 按 5.4 倍计费；需重启 IDE/CLI、运行 kirocrew restart 或刷新 Web 以加载最新模型列表。
key_points_zh: 覆盖 IDE、CLI、Crew 与 Web，定位实验性支持。
上下文窗口 50 万 token。
20 万 token 内 2.7 倍 credits，超出部分按 5.4 倍计费。
events.importance_reason_zh: 上下文超过 20 万 token 时 credits 翻倍，长会话的实际成本需要按 token 区间核算。
events.title_en: Kiro adds experimental Grok 4.7 with tiered credit pricing
events.summary_en: Grok 4.7 is available with experimental support in Kiro IDE, CLI, Crew and Web for Pro, Pro+, Pro Max and Power customers, with a 500K-token context window. Requests up to 200K tokens carry a 2.7x credit multiplier; requests beyond that are billed at 5.4x. Users must restart the IDE or CLI, run kirocrew restart, or refresh Web to load the latest model list.
key_points_en: Covers IDE, CLI, Crew and Web as experimental support.
500K-token context window.
2.7x credits up to 200K tokens and 5.4x beyond that.
events.importance_reason_en: Credits double past 200K tokens, so long sessions need to be costed by token band.

events.title_zh: Kiro 预览企业统一策略管理
events.summary_zh: Kiro Enterprise Management 进入预览，仅对 us-east-1 新建的 Kiro 配置文件开放，既有配置文件与欧洲区域后续支持。管理员在 AWS 控制台编写一份策略即可下发到 Kiro IDE、CLI、Web 与 Crew LTS（IDE 需 1.4.154 及以上，CLI 需 3.1.0 及以上）；策略包含模型、命令、文件、联网与 MCP 的允许/拒绝/询问规则，默认模型与日志设置，以及分发的 steering 文件、Skills 与 Powers，可按全员、组或个人生效，身份源支持 IAM Identity Center、Okta 与 Microsoft Entra ID。
key_points_zh: 单一策略覆盖 IDE、CLI、Web 与 Crew LTS。
规则可对模型、命令、文件、联网与 MCP 调用生效。
仅限 us-east-1 新建配置文件，既有配置待支持。
events.importance_reason_zh: 把权限、默认设置与 Skills 统一下发，降低了多客户端团队的一致性与合规成本。
events.title_en: Kiro previews one enterprise policy across every client
events.summary_en: Kiro Enterprise Management is in preview for newly created Kiro profiles in US East (N. Virginia) only, with existing profiles and Europe to follow. Administrators write one policy in the AWS console and every developer receives it in Kiro IDE, CLI, Web and Crew LTS, provided the IDE is 1.4.154+ and the CLI is 3.1.0+. The policy holds allow/deny/ask rules for models, shell commands, file reads and writes, web search and MCP tools, settings such as the default model and prompt logging, and the steering files, Skills and Powers to distribute. Rules can target everyone, a group or one user, with IAM Identity Center, Okta or Microsoft Entra ID as the identity source.
key_points_en: One policy covers IDE, CLI, Web and Crew LTS.
Rules apply to models, commands, files, web search and MCP calls.
Preview limited to new profiles in us-east-1; existing profiles come later.
events.importance_reason_en: Centralizing permissions, defaults and Skills lowers consistency and compliance overhead for multi-client teams.

events.title_zh: Kiro 额度池支持 Okta 与 Microsoft Entra ID
events.summary_zh: 直接连接 Okta 或 Microsoft Entra ID 的 Kiro 配置文件现可用额度池共享 credits，此前仅支持 AWS IAM Identity Center。管理员可在控制台 Access management > Credit sharing 添加用户与组、购买席位、设置使用上限，并用迁移向导移动既有订阅者；新建的三种身份源配置文件默认启用额度池。
key_points_zh: 额度池扩展到 Okta 与 Microsoft Entra ID。
可按用户与组设置使用上限。
新建配置文件默认启用额度池。
events.importance_reason_zh: 身份源不再是启用额度池的前置条件，团队可以按组织实际使用的 IdP 统一计费。
events.title_en: Kiro credit pooling supports Okta and Microsoft Entra ID
events.summary_en: Kiro profiles that connect directly to Okta or Microsoft Entra ID can now share credits through credit pooling, previously limited to AWS IAM Identity Center. Administrators add users and groups, buy seats, set usage limits and move existing subscribers with the Switch to credit sharing wizard under Access management > Credit sharing, and new profiles on all three identity sources start with credit pooling.
key_points_en: Credit pooling extends to Okta and Microsoft Entra ID.
Usage limits can be set per user and group.
New profiles start with credit pooling enabled.
events.importance_reason_en: The identity provider is no longer a prerequisite for pooling, so teams can bill through the IdP they actually use.

events.title_zh: Kiro IDE 增加 Approve for me 权限模式
events.summary_zh: Kiro IDE 1.4.154 在聊天中加入 Approve for me：自动批准常规操作、阻止高风险操作、不确定时询问用户；在可用地区，Autopilot 开关变为包含 Supervised、Accept file changes 与 Approve for me 的权限模式菜单。该版本还带来组织托管设置、记忆视图排序与过滤、工作流运行改进，并修复停止轮次、spec 任务与工作区信任问题。
key_points_zh: Approve for me 自动批准常规操作、阻止高风险操作。
Autopilot 开关改为三档权限模式菜单。
新增组织托管设置与记忆视图排序过滤。
events.importance_reason_zh: 审批粒度从“全自动/全手动”变成三档，团队可以按任务风险选择自动化程度。
events.title_en: Kiro IDE adds an Approve for me permission mode
events.summary_en: Kiro IDE 1.4.154 adds Approve for me to chat: Kiro approves routine actions, blocks risky ones and asks when unsure. Where available, the Autopilot toggle becomes a permission mode menu with Supervised, Accept file changes and Approve for me. The release also brings organization-managed settings, memory view sorting and filtering, workflow run improvements, and fixes for stopped turns, spec tasks and workspace trust.
key_points_en: Approve for me approves routine actions and blocks risky ones.
The Autopilot toggle becomes a three-mode permission menu.
Adds organization-managed settings and memory view sorting.
events.importance_reason_en: Approval granularity moves from all-or-nothing to three levels, so teams can match automation to task risk.

events.title_zh: Kiro CLI 3.2 增加全屏图表查看与输出详略设置
events.summary_zh: Kiro CLI 3.2.0 增加超出终端宽度的 Mermaid 图表全屏查看、无需 OAuth 配置即可登录更多 MCP 服务器，并允许耗尽的 workflow loop 再执行一次或直接结束；3.2.1 把输出详略设置开放给所有用户，可在 /settings 选择每次工具调用显示一行到完整输出，并修复无图形会话的 Linux 主机与 Identity Center 参数下的登录问题。
key_points_zh: Mermaid 图表可全屏查看。
无需 OAuth 配置即可登录更多 MCP 服务器。
输出详略可在 /settings 中选择。
events.importance_reason_zh: 输出详略与图表查看改善长任务的可读性，MCP 登录简化则减少首次接入成本。
events.title_en: Kiro CLI 3.2 adds a full-screen diagram viewer and output detail settings
events.summary_en: Kiro CLI 3.2.0 adds a full-screen viewer for Mermaid diagrams too wide for the terminal and signs users in to more MCP servers without OAuth configuration, and lets a workflow loop that used all its iterations run once more or finish. 3.2.1 opens output details to everyone, letting users choose in /settings how much of each tool call to show, from one line to the full output, and fixes sign-in on Linux hosts without a graphical session and with Identity Center flags.
key_points_en: Mermaid diagrams can be viewed full screen.
More MCP servers sign in without OAuth configuration.
Output detail is configurable in /settings.
events.importance_reason_en: Output detail and diagram viewing improve readability in long tasks, while simpler MCP sign-in lowers first-time setup cost.

events.title_zh: Anthropic 启动 IPO 路演
events.summary_zh: Anthropic PBC 宣布为其拟议的 A 类普通股首次公开募股启动路演。官方摘要未列出定价区间、发行规模或上市时间。
key_points_zh: 为其拟议 IPO 启动路演。
发行标的为 A 类普通股。
未公布定价区间、规模与上市时间。
events.importance_reason_zh: 路演是 S-1 之后的实质进展，会影响公司融资节奏与对外合作的稳定性判断。
events.title_en: Anthropic launches roadshow for its proposed IPO
events.summary_en: Anthropic PBC launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering of Class A common stock. The summary lists no price range, offering size or listing date.
key_points_en: The roadshow has started for the proposed IPO.
The offering covers Class A common stock.
No price range, size or listing date was disclosed.
events.importance_reason_en: A roadshow is concrete progress after the S-1 and affects how partners read the company's funding timeline.

events.title_zh: TRAE v3.4.18 增加目录信任与 Agent Window Hooks 编辑
events.summary_zh: TRAE 发布 v3.4.18：打开或创建项目时需确认目录信任，未信任目录中的项目规则、技能、命令和 Hooks 不会加载，终端命令也不会运行；可在 Agent Window 中直接编辑全局与项目 Hooks。新版本还支持从历史会话打开关联工作区或转到 Agent Window，macOS Dock 同步展示最近工作区，文档产物可查看代码与表格的结构化差异，并优化斜杠菜单预加载、Remote SSH 连接等待和行内翻译同步。
key_points_zh: 打开或创建项目时确认目录信任。
未信任目录中的规则、技能、命令和 Hooks 不加载，终端命令不运行。
可在 Agent Window 直接编辑全局与项目 Hooks。
历史会话可打开关联工作区或转到 Agent Window。
文档产物支持代码与表格的结构化差异查看。
events.importance_reason_zh: 目录信任把项目级配置与命令执行纳入显式授权，直接改变打开外部仓库时的默认安全边界。
events.title_en: TRAE v3.4.18 adds directory trust and Hooks editing in the Agent Window
events.summary_en: TRAE v3.4.18 asks users to confirm directory trust when opening or creating a project; in untrusted directories, project rules, skills, commands and Hooks are not loaded and terminal commands do not run. Global and project Hooks can now be edited directly in the Agent Window. The release also opens linked workspaces or switches to the Agent Window from history, mirrors recent workspaces in the macOS Dock menu, adds structured code and table diffs in document artifacts, and improves slash-menu preloading, Remote SSH connection waits and inline-translation sync.
key_points_en: Directory trust is confirmed when opening or creating a project.
Untrusted directories load no rules, skills, commands or Hooks, and run no terminal commands.
Global and project Hooks can be edited in the Agent Window.
History sessions can open a linked workspace or switch to the Agent Window.
Document artifacts show structured code and table diffs.
events.importance_reason_en: Directory trust turns project-level configuration and command execution into an explicit authorization step, changing the default security boundary for outside repositories.

events.title_zh: Pi 1.5.1 增加空闲缓存预热与 Anthropic 消息线程
events.summary_zh: Pi 1.5.1 新增 pi auth login/logout 独立登录命令、空闲提示缓存预热（预计划算时最长保持 30 分钟）、Anthropic 消息线程（只发送新消息并保留完整请求回退）、更丰富的 Mermaid 图与 GitHub Copilot 分类器调用。破坏性变更包括自定义 GrepOperations.readFile 不再用于上下文行，以及禁用工具时不再发送空 tools 数组。
key_points_zh: 新增 pi auth login/logout，无需进入会话。
空闲缓存预热最长 30 分钟，按模型 cache.ttl 计时。
可选 GitHub Copilot 分类器做类型化决策。
events.importance_reason_zh: 消息线程与缓存预热同时作用于延迟和账单，需要按供应商缓存策略核对收益。
events.title_en: Pi 1.5.1 adds idle cache warming and Anthropic message threads
events.summary_en: Pi 1.5.1 adds pi auth login/logout for signing in without starting a session, idle prompt cache warming that keeps eligible caches warm for up to 30 minutes when a refresh is expected to pay for itself, and Anthropic message threads that send only new messages with a full-request fallback. It also adds richer Mermaid diagrams and GitHub Copilot classifier calls. Breaking changes: custom GrepOperations.readFile callbacks no longer handle context lines, and disabled tools no longer send an empty tools array.
key_points_en: pi auth login/logout works without starting a session.
Idle cache warming lasts up to 30 minutes, timed from the model's cache TTL.
GitHub Copilot classifiers are callable for typed decisions.
events.importance_reason_en: Message threads and cache warming affect both latency and billing, so the gain depends on each provider's cache policy.

events.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.321 默认切换到 Claude Fable 5.2
events.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.321 增加 Claude Fable 5.2（claude-fable-5-2）并设为默认 Fable 模型：100 万 token 上下文，每百万 token 输入 8 美元、输出 40 美元，缓存读取 0.20 美元。已保存的 Fable 5.1 选择在 Pro 与 Max 上自动迁移，Team 与 Enterprise 需组织允许；另新增 claude remote-control --settings 与 VS Code 凭据冲突提示。
key_points_zh: Fable 5.2 成为默认 Fable 模型，上下文 100 万 token。
价格 8/40 美元每百万 token，缓存读取 0.20 美元。
Pro 与 Max 自动迁移，Team 与 Enterprise 需组织允许。
events.importance_reason_zh: 默认模型切换会改变既有会话的成本结构，缓存读取价格也需要单独评估。
events.title_en: Claude Code 2.1.321 makes Claude Fable 5.2 the default
events.summary_en: Claude Code 2.1.321 adds Claude Fable 5.2 (claude-fable-5-2) and makes it the default Fable model: a one-million-token context at $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens, with $0.20 per million cache reads. Saved Fable 5.1 picks migrate automatically on Pro and Max, and on Team and Enterprise once the organization allows it. The release also adds claude remote-control --settings and a VS Code warning when both an auth token and an API key are set.
key_points_en: Fable 5.2 becomes the default Fable model with a 1M-token context.
$8/$40 per million tokens, with $0.20 per million cache reads.
Pro and Max migrate automatically; Team and Enterprise need org approval.
events.importance_reason_en: A default model switch changes the cost profile of existing sessions, and the cache-read price deserves its own review.

events.title_zh: Google 发布 Gemini Robotics 2.5
events.summary_zh: Google 发布 Gemini Robotics 2.5，称其为目前最强的视觉-语言-动作模型，在机器人灵巧性、可靠性与安全性方面有所提升。官方摘要未给出基准数字、支持硬件或开放范围。
key_points_zh: 定位为 Google 最强的视觉-语言-动作模型。
官方称提升灵巧性、可靠性与安全性。
公告未披露基准分数或可用范围。
events.importance_reason_zh: 具身智能的能力上限取决于这类基础模型，但本次公告缺少可比较指标，实际影响有待后续数据。
events.title_en: Google introduces Gemini Robotics 2.5
events.summary_en: Google introduced Gemini Robotics 2.5, describing it as its most capable vision-language-action model, with improved robot dexterity, reliability and safety. The summary gives no benchmark numbers, supported hardware or availability details.
key_points_en: Described as Google's most capable vision-language-action model.
Google claims better dexterity, reliability and safety.
No benchmark scores or availability details were disclosed.
events.importance_reason_en: These foundation models set the ceiling for embodied AI, but without comparable metrics the practical impact is still open.

events.title_zh: ChatGPT Enterprise 上架 AWS Marketplace
events.summary_zh: ChatGPT Enterprise 现可通过 AWS Marketplace 采购，企业可沿用既有的 AWS 采购与计费关系，简化采购流程。官方摘要未说明价格差异或适用地区。
key_points_zh: 通过 AWS Marketplace 提供。
复用企业既有采购与计费关系。
未说明价格差异与地区限制。
events.importance_reason_zh: 采购路径并入云账单，通常会缩短企业采购周期，但价格与合同条款仍需单独核对。
events.title_en: ChatGPT Enterprise is now available in AWS Marketplace
events.summary_en: ChatGPT Enterprise is now available through AWS Marketplace, so organizations can use their existing AWS purchasing and billing relationships to simplify procurement. The summary does not mention price differences or regional limits.
key_points_en: Available through AWS Marketplace.
Reuses an organization's existing AWS purchasing and billing.
No price differences or regional limits were given.
events.importance_reason_en: Folding procurement into the cloud bill usually shortens enterprise purchase cycles, though pricing and contract terms still need separate review.

events.title_zh: Claude Fable 5.2 在 GitHub Copilot 正式可用
events.summary_zh: Claude Fable 5.2 在 GitHub Copilot 正式可用，面向大型代码库中的复杂多步编码任务。GitHub 称早期测试中它以更少步骤与工具调用解决更多任务；该模型默认要求数据保留以运行 Anthropic 的安全分类器，符合条件的企业客户可使用零数据保留，企业策略默认关闭该模型。
key_points_zh: 面向大型代码库的复杂多步编码任务。
GitHub 称其用更少步骤与工具调用解决更多任务。
默认要求数据保留以运行安全分类器。
企业策略默认关闭，管理员需手动启用。
events.importance_reason_zh: 默认开启的数据保留改变了企业合规评估的前提，启用前需要与现有零数据保留约定对照。
events.title_en: Claude Fable 5.2 is generally available in GitHub Copilot
events.summary_en: Claude Fable 5.2 is generally available in GitHub Copilot for complex, multistep coding tasks in large codebases. GitHub says early testing solved more tasks than Fable 5.1 with fewer steps and tool calls. The model requires data retention by default to run Anthropic's safety classifiers, with zero data retention available to certain eligible enterprise customers; the enterprise policy is off by default.
key_points_en: Targets complex, multistep coding in large codebases.
GitHub says it solved more tasks with fewer steps and tool calls.
Requires data retention by default for safety classifiers.
The enterprise policy is off by default and must be enabled.
events.importance_reason_en: Retention on by default changes the compliance baseline, so teams must compare it with existing zero-retention commitments before enabling.

events.title_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.108 增加共享索引与沙箱目录跟随
events.summary_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.108 新增 /index 命令，并为符合条件的仓库默认启用受管共享 tgrep 索引；沙箱开启时，/cd 后会重启本地 MCP 服务器以套用新目录的拒绝路径；Windows 增加仅枚举的目录授权，Grok 4.6/4.7 的 PDF 附件改为文件引用而不是整轮失败。
key_points_zh: /index 与默认启用的受管共享 tgrep 索引。
/cd 后重启本地 MCP 服务器以跟随目录策略。
Windows 新增枚举式目录授权（enumeratePaths）。
events.importance_reason_zh: 索引共享与目录策略跟随，减少了多仓库会话中重复建索引与沙箱越权的问题。
events.title_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.108 adds shared indexing and sandbox-aware directory changes
events.summary_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.108 adds /index commands and turns on managed shared tgrep indexing by default for eligible repositories. With the sandbox on, a running local MCP server restarts after /cd so it follows the new directory's denied paths. Windows gains enumerate-only directory grants, and PDF attachments on Grok 4.6/4.7 fall back to file references instead of failing the turn.
key_points_en: /index commands and managed shared tgrep indexing on by default.
Local MCP servers restart after /cd to follow directory policy.
Windows gains enumerate-only directory grants.
events.importance_reason_en: Shared indexing and directory-aware policy cut duplicate index builds and sandbox escapes in multi-repo sessions.

events.title_zh: Google MaxText 支持最长 1400 万 token 的 TPU 长上下文训练
events.summary_zh: Google Cloud 的 MaxText 框架新增上下文并行，支持在 Cloud TPU 上训练最长 1400 万 token 的长上下文。实现包含 All-gather、A2A、P2P 与 USP 四种策略，并借助 Tokamax Splash Attention 内核管理注意力计算与显存瓶颈，避免在 HBM 中物化完整的键值序列。开发者可在 MaxText v0.2.4 中使用这些能力。
key_points_zh: 支持最长 1400 万 token 的 TPU 长上下文训练。
提供 All-gather、A2A、P2P、USP 四种上下文并行策略。
使用 Tokamax Splash Attention 内核管理计算与显存。
避免在 HBM 中物化完整 KV 序列，可在 v0.2.4 中使用。
events.importance_reason_zh: 把长上下文训练推到千万 token 量级，会改变长文档、代码库与多模态序列的训练可行性。
events.title_en: Google MaxText supports long-context TPU training up to 14 million tokens
events.summary_en: Google Cloud’s MaxText framework added context parallelism for long-context training on Cloud TPUs at up to 14 million tokens. The implementation offers four strategies—All-gather, A2A, P2P and USP—and uses the Tokamax Splash Attention kernel to manage attention compute and memory bottlenecks without materializing full key-value sequences in HBM. Developers can use the capabilities in MaxText v0.2.4.
key_points_en: Long-context TPU training up to 14 million tokens.
Four context-parallel strategies: All-gather, A2A, P2P and USP.
Uses the Tokamax Splash Attention kernel to manage compute and memory.
Avoids materializing full KV sequences in HBM; available in v0.2.4.
events.importance_reason_en: Pushing long-context training to tens of millions of tokens changes what is feasible for long documents, codebases and multimodal sequences.

corrections.reason_zh: RSSHub 条目只提供日期，原事件误用了 00:00 时间；改为日期精度，避免伪造具体时刻。
corrections.reason_en: The RSSHub entry supplies only a date, so the original event wrongly used a 00:00 time. It now uses date precision to avoid implying an exact time.

events.title_zh: Google AI Studio 可直接用提示词构建 Maps 应用
events.summary_zh: 开发者现在可在 Google AI Studio 中通过提示 Gemini 使用真实地理空间概念，构建由 Google Maps Platform 驱动的应用。该集成提供一键生成的演示密钥，无需跳转 Cloud Console 或绑定信用卡；开发者可直接访问 Maps、Places 与 Routes 等核心 API，并获得每日沙箱配额用于原型开发。
key_points_zh: 可在 AI Studio 中通过提示词构建 Maps 应用。
一键生成演示密钥，无需 Cloud Console 或信用卡。
可直接访问 Maps、Places 与 Routes 等 API。
提供每日沙箱配额用于原型开发。
events.importance_reason_zh: 把地图 API 的开通与原型流程压缩到提示词内，降低了地理空间应用的首个可用版本门槛。
events.title_en: Google AI Studio lets developers build Maps apps from prompts
events.summary_en: Developers can now build applications powered by Google Maps Platform directly in Google AI Studio by prompting Gemini with real-world geospatial concepts. The integration provides one-click demo keys generated without Cloud Console redirects or a credit card, immediate access to core Maps, Places and Routes APIs, and daily sandbox quotas for prototyping.
key_points_en: Build Maps apps from prompts in AI Studio.
One-click demo keys need no Cloud Console redirect or credit card.
Immediate access to Maps, Places and Routes APIs.
Daily sandbox quotas support prototyping.
events.importance_reason_en: Compressing Maps API setup and prototyping into a prompt lowers the barrier to a first working geospatial app.

corrections.reason_zh: RSSHub 条目只提供日期，原事件误用了 00:00 时间；改为日期精度，避免伪造具体时刻。
